class.name: AudioDeviceSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the audio output and input device.

method.name: get_input_device
method.description: Returns the pending input device, [code]"Default"[/code] for the default device of the system.

method.name: get_output_device
method.description: Returns the pending output device, [code]"Default"[/code] for the default device of the system.

method.name: is_device_selection_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the active audio driver can switch the device: WASAPI, PulseAudio, ALSA, and CoreAudio on macOS. Returns [code]false[/code] for all other drivers (XAudio2, Android, iOS, Web, Dummy) and when no audio driver is running.

method.name: set_input_device
method.description: Sets the input device used for audio capture. A name that [method AudioServer.get_input_device_list] does not contain, or an empty string, becomes [code]"Default"[/code]. Only takes effect if [member ProjectSettings.audio/driver/enable_input] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_output_device
method.description: Sets the output device. A name that [method AudioServer.get_output_device_list] does not contain, or an empty string, becomes [code]"Default"[/code].

signal.name: input_device_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AudioDeviceSettings.input_device] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it to restart voice chat or recording with the new device.

signal.name: output_device_changed
signal.description: Emitted once when a changed [member AudioDeviceSettings.output_device] reached the engine: by [method SettingsServer.apply] (also at startup after the settings file is loaded, and after [method SettingsServer.reset_to_defaults] in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_IMMEDIATE]), [method SettingsServer.apply_with_confirmation], [method SettingsServer.cancel_confirmation] (with the restored value) or a session override. Not emitted for pending changes in [constant SettingsServer.APPLY_MODE_MANUAL]; [signal SettingsServer.value_changed] reports those. Use it to show the device in use, for example after the player picked another one in the options menu.
